roic.description: 7% return on capital - below expectations for branded consumer goods.

fcf.description: Generates ~$3.2B in free cash flow despite brand challenges.

fcf_margin.description: 12% FCF margin - decent but not stellar for food brands.

revenue_cagr.description: Slight revenue decline as legacy brands face competition.

net_income_cagr.description: Flat profit growth. Turnaround taking longer than expected.

operating_margin_stability.description: Operating margins around 20-23%, under pressure from costs.

reinvestment_rate.description: Low capex needs but investing in brand revitalization.

dividend_cagr.description: Dividend cut and held flat. Preserving cash for turnaround.

net_debt_ebitda.description: High debt load from merger, but actively paying down.

recession_performance.description: Consumer staples hold up well. Pantry-loading benefits.
